notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (labels from left pages 6/8, amounts from right pages 7/9). Disbursements are listed by object with no function; object lines printed in more than one fund column are split by fund column (split_from) and given the fund's function (General, Donation, Grant -> general government; Street -> streets/highways; Fire -> public safety; proprietary Pool and Park -> culture/recreation, Water/Sewer -> utilities), with Rock and Gravel (streets), Fire Department (public safety), Garbage (utilities) by label. Printed governmental totals exclude the 20,000 transfer in and 85,000 transfer out. Governmental roll-forward: 726,927.31 + 1,464,517.95 - 459,043.35 + 20,000 - 85,000 = 1,667,401.91. Business-type roll-forward from Exhibit IV (p12) in cash terms: -117,617.95 + 144,217.62 + 6,200 grants (outside printed total) - 254,616.71 + 65,000 = -156,817.04. Pool and Park insurance claim 17,747.14 shown as operating receipt. Balance sheet uses the Total column of Exhibit I (governmental + business-type, total 1,510,584.87), while top-level ending_cash is governmental funds only. Detail: combining budget-and-actual schedules pp13-15 recorded per fund (General, Street, Donation; Pool and Park, Water). The trimmed PDF shows only these fund columns (Fire, Grant and Sewer columns and per-fund budget columns are not in the trimmed pages), so budget_final is null. Proprietary schedule pp15 budget column is for all enterprise funds combined so not used. These duplicate the basic statements by fund but are the supplementary schedules. Read pages 1-16 of 16.
